title: The Silence of the Lambs
author: Thomas Harris
comment: A masterclass in psychological suspense. The interactions between Clarice and Hannibal Lecter are chilling and brilliant.

title: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
author: Stephen Chbosky
comment: A deeply touching coming-of-age story. It captures the bittersweet feel of growing up, friendship, and mental health so perfectly.

title: The Guest List
author: Lucy Foley
comment: A classic whodunnit set on a remote Irish island. Very atmospheric with lots of twists and changing perspectives.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
comment: An absolute classic about justice, empathy, and growing up. Atticus Finch remains one of my favorite characters in literature.

title: And Then There Were None
author: Agatha Christie
comment: The ultimate mystery novel. Ten strangers on an island, a spooky nursery rhyme, and a puzzle that keeps you guessing until the absolute end.

title: Verity
author: Colleen Hoover
comment: A dark, twisted romantic thriller that kept me up reading until 3 AM. The ending is completely wild and leaves you questioning everything.

title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
comment: A gorgeous, heartbreaking story about Old Hollywood glamour, ambition, and the secrets behind Evelyn's seven marriages.

title: Harry Potter
author: J.K. Rowling
comment: The magical world I keep going back to. Cozy, nostalgic, and full of childhood adventure.
